## Requirement acceptance and evidence

| Requirement | Acceptance criteria | Status | Evidence | Open finding |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `REQ-001` | A representative Task invocation resolves the established project root, identifies its ROLE.md as governing, applies that role before any Task mutation or delegation decision, and does not spawn or substitute a second Director. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-002` | The reusable role and Task contracts use one compatible definition and distinguish a project Task from a subtask, Codex conversation, native goal, TRD, implementation plan, and child-agent assignment. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-003` | ROLES-depo/project-director-ROLE.md and SKILLS-depo/task/SKILL.md assign every listed decision to the Project Director, keep Task-ledger mutations with the Director, and prevent child agents from claiming project completion or expanding authority. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-004` | Representative simple, decomposable-complex, and uncertain-nondecomposable scenarios produce an explicit workflow classification with a concise evidence-based rationale and no invented numeric threshold. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-005` | A representative simple task stays with the Director, uses no unnecessary child-agent workflow, and receives proportionate verification before completion. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-006` | A representative decomposable task produces complete subtask contracts, identifies ordering and safe parallel work, prevents conflicting write ownership, and retains Director-level decisions with the Director. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-007` | Each delegated solver, reviewer, synthesizer, or implementer has a documented task profile, selected role, role-file paths, fit rationale, authority limits, and stopping condition derived from a fresh valid catalog. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-008` | A no-fit scenario either produces a non-overwriting role bundle that passes live catalog validation before use or reports an exact capability or authority blocker, while an existing-fit scenario creates no duplicate role. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-009` | A representative uncertain task records why the adversarial path was selected, gives every solver the same objective and governing evidence, distinguishes roles or perspectives, preserves independent candidate solutions, and uses a task-appropriate count rather than a fixed global number. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-010` | Scenario checks preserve feasible user-specified orchestration exactly and produce a specific disclosed conflict with no silent substitution when the instruction is infeasible or unauthorized. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-011` | The orchestration record contains a one-to-one solver-output-to-reviewer mapping, no unreviewed candidate enters synthesis, and no reviewer silently becomes the final Project Director. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-012` | A failing-review scenario preserves the original candidate and outcome, routes findings to the correct solver, produces a materially revised candidate, and records the next review result without treating rejection as completion. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-013` | The senior synthesis receives every accepted candidate and material review finding, preserves compatible contributions, explains resolved differences, and returns one integrated proposal to the Project Director. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-014` | A conflict scenario produces one shared conflict record, targeted revised candidates from every affected solver, repeated required reviews, and another synthesis attempt without presenting an unresolved conflict as fused. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-015` | Before execution, the authoritative workflow records whether the senior synthesis agent or the Project Director owns implementation, using the policy approved through Q-001, and does not label a candidate, review pass, or synthesis artifact as implementation. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-016` | Completion scenarios contain Director-inspected criterion-by-criterion evidence, reject child-agent completion messages as sole proof, distinguish unexercised external or runtime behavior, and produce one truthful final Task Response. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-017` | A later Project Director can reconstruct the current workflow state from governed project records using concise decisions and evidence rather than private deliberative content, a full transcript, stale memory, or inference from child-agent status alone. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-018` | Contract and scenario checks identify one authority for each state system, report contradictions instead of merging them, and show that Task or role activation alone performs no separately governed external or destructive action. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-019` | A no-progress or unavailable-capability scenario stops without fabricated fusion or completion, records the exact blocker and smallest needed decision or state change, and can resume from the durable Task record. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-020` | The implementation change set contains requirement-linked changes in both required reusable targets and contains no corresponding change in active root ROLE.md or .agents/skills/task/. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-021` | A requirement-to-artifact impact matrix records a changed or unchanged disposition with evidence for each named package and file, and no speculative or duplicate edit occurs merely because the package participates in the workflow. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-022` | Pre-change and post-change scoped hashes and repository status prove every protected active path is unchanged, no install or synchronization operation ran, and the existing deletion of ROLES-depo/sys4ai-depot-ROLE.md was neither restored nor modified. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-023` | All affected source-package structural validators and focused tests pass, cross-package checks cover every changed contract, the reusable role passes its applicable review, scoped diff checks pass, no new generated residue remains, and protected active-copy hashes remain unchanged. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
